# 转子动力学与振动

_Rotordynamics & Vibration_

发动机转子、支承和机匣共同构成动力学系统。阅读应从质量、刚度、阻尼和激励入手，再理解临界转速、响应及测量之间的关系。

_Rotors, supports and casings form a coupled dynamic system. Start with mass, stiffness, damping and excitation, then connect critical speeds, response and measurement._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 将激励来源、响应形式和测点位置分开记录。

_Record excitation sources, response forms and sensor locations separately._

- 关注转子支承、连接和边界条件，避免只比较固有频率。

_Consider supports, joints and boundary conditions rather than comparing natural frequencies alone._

- 本条目先用结构讲义与公开模型建立索引，再逐步补充经过核对的转子动力学专题资料。

_Use the structural lecture and public models as initial references, then add verified specialist rotordynamics material._
